answer_1.quote: We analyze the on-device LLM features currently released on mobile phones by major manufacturers, dividing them into 5 major categories with 20 tasks. Based on this, we propose SmartBench, the first (Chinese) benchmark for assessing the capabilities of on-device LLMs in mobile scenarios.
answer_1.outputs: The paper evaluates generated outputs such as summaries, answers, created text, extracted information, and notification summaries in mobile scenarios.

answer_2.quote: In SmartBench, we develop detailed automated evaluation criteria for each category/task.

answer_3.quote: Evaluations of subjective tasks are commonly conducted using the LLM-as-a-Judge paradigm. In SmartBench, we develop detailed automated evaluation criteria for each category/task.

answer_4.quote: We carry out a human test with six human experts in this subsection.
answer_4.guideline: Human experts are asked to rank the outputs generated by different on-device models for each question, and the rankings are compared with those from the judge LLM.
